headline: Prices rise in the Canary Islands 3.8% in August, driven by higher gasoline prices
summary: Consumer prices in the Canary Islands rose 3.8% year on year in August, driven by higher gasoline prices. The figure is the regional CPI reading.
why: Consumer price inflation shapes central bank policy expectations and real household spending power, and Spain's regions are tracked closely for national inflation trends.

original_headline: Los precios se incrementan en Canarias un 3,8% en agosto impulsado por el encarecimiento de la gasolina
